title: Prakas on Procedures for the Post-Notification of Business Combinations
text:
Unofficial Translation
Kingdom of Cambodia
Nation Religion King
Ministry of Commerce
No. 178 P.N.A.KBB.PRK
Prakas
On
Procedures for the Post-Notification of Business Combinations
Minister of Commerce
- Having seen the Constitution of the Kingdom of Cambodia;
- Having seen the Royal Decree No. NS/RKT/0918/925 dated 6 September 2018 on the Appointment of the
Royal Government of Cambodia;
- Having seen the Royal Decree No. NS/RKT/0320/421 dated 30 March 2020 on the Appointment and
Adjustment of the Composition of the Royal Government of Cambodia;
- Having seen the Royal Kram No. NS/RKM/0618/012 dated 28 June 2018 promulgating the Law on
the Organization and Functioning of the Council of Ministers;
- Having seen the Royal Kram No. NS/RKM/0196/16 dated 24 January 1996 promulgating the Law on
the Establishment Ministry of Commerce;
- Having seen the Royal Decree No. NS/RKT/1021/013 dated 05 October 2021 promulgating of the Law
on Competition;
- Having seen Sub-Decree No. 38 ANKR.BK dated 16 March 2020 on the Organization and Functioning
of the Ministry of Commerce;
- Having seen the Sub-Decree No. 37 ANKR.BK dated 17 February 2022 on the Organization and
Functioning of the Cambodia Competition Commission;
- Having seen the Sub-Decree No. 60 ANKR.BK dated 6 March 2023 on the Requirements and
Procedures for Business Combinations; and
- According to the necessity of the Ministry of Commerce
1/4

Unofficial Translation
Hereby Decides
Article 1.-
This Prakas sets out the procedures for notification of Business Combinations subject to Post-
Notification obligation for the purpose of granting the Business Combination acknowledgment and
legitimacy.
Article 2.-
This Prakas applies to any Business Combination that is subject to Post-Notification pursuant
to Article 13 of Sub-Decree No. 60 ANKR.BK dated 6 March 2023 on the Requirements and
Procedures for Business Combinations.
Article 3.-
Parties to the Business Combination subject to Post-Notification pursuant to Article 4 of this
Prakas shall notify the Cambodia Competition Commission (“CCC”) within 30 (thirty) working days
after substantive completion of the Business Combination as stipulated in Article 13 of the Sub-Decree
on Requirements and Procedures for Business Combinations and Article 5 of this Prakas.
Article 4.-
A Post-Notification shall be required for Parties to the Business Combination that is not subject
to a Pre-Notification obligation under Chapter 2 of the Sub-Decree on the Requirements and
Procedures for Business Combinations, in the event that the threshold meet or exceed 50 (fifty) percent
of the threshold specified in Article 3, 4 or 5 of the Decision No. 095 P.N. A.KBB.SSR dated 14 March
2023 on the Pre-Notification Thresholds for Business Combinations.
In the event that Decision No. 095 P.N. A.KBB.SSR dated 14 March 2023 on the Pre-
Notification Thresholds for Business Combinations is amended, the requirement set forth in the
preceding paragraph will still remain in effect.
The CCC may amend the percentage required for Post-Notification specified in paragraph 1
above in accordance with the actual circumstances.
Article 5.-
After completion, one of the Notifying Parties of the Business Combination subject to Post-
Notification shall submit a Post-Notification form to the CCC, including any required documents and
information as specified in the notification form (as attached in the annex of this Prakas).
2/ 4

Unofficial Translation
The CCC may amend the attached Post-Notification form in the annex of this Prakas if
necessary.
The Consumer Protection Competition and Fraud Repression (“CCF”), the secretariat of the
CCC, is appointed to receive the Post-Notification form.
Article 6.-
The Notifying Party of the Business Combination shall submit the following documents or
information:
a) a Post-Notification of the Businesses Combinations form;
b) a copy of the certificate of tax compliance from the General Department of Taxation of
Ministry of Economic and Finance;
c) a copy of the business registration and any documents pertaining to alienation from
Ministry of Commerce and relevant ministries and institutions;
d) a copy of documents from relevant sectoral regulators ministries, and institutions
pertaining to the request for Business Combinations (if applicable);
e) a copy of the receipt of Post-Notification of the Businesses Combinations.
Article 7.-
Within 7 (seven) working days of receipt of a Post-Notification of the Businesses
Combinations form stipulated in Article 5 of this Prakas, CCF Directorate-General shall issue a notice
to the Notifying Party of the Business Combination confirming fulfillment of the obligation of Post-
Completion Business Combination notification under Article 13 of the Sub-Decree on Requirements
and Procedures for Business Combinations or identify any defect or omission in the submitted
documents and information to the CCC.
Upon receiving notice from the CCF Directorate-General concerning any defect or omission
in the submitted documents and information to the CCC, the Notifying Party shall submit additional
documents and information that prove the documents and information submitted to the CCC were not
materially defective or omitted within 15 (fifteen) working days. If the Notifying Party fails to provide
the required documents and information within the specified timeframe, the Post-Notification is
deemed to be void. In this case, the Notifying Party of the Businesses Combinations shall notify the
CCC again regarding the Post-Notification.
The CCF Directorate-General may issue a notice to the Notifying Parties of the Businesses
Combinations to extend the timeframe set forth in the second paragraph from the Notifying Parties
above with reasonable grounds.
3/ 4

Unofficial Translation
Article 8.-
Any provisions contrary to this Prakas shall be abrogated.
Article 9.-
Members of the CCC, Director of the Cabinet, Delegate of the Royal Government in charge as
Director-General of the Consumer Protection Competition and Fraud Repression Directorate-General,
and Heads of all relevant authorities shall be responsible for the implementation of this Prakas in
accordance with their respective duties from the date of signature.
[Buddhist Date]
Done in Phnom Penh, 14th June 2023
Minister of Commerce
and Chairman of the Cambodia Competition Commission
[seal and signature]
Pan Sorasak
Recipients:
- Council of Ministers
- Cabinet of Samdech Akka Moha Sena Padei Techo Prime Minister
- Cabinet of Samdech, His Excellency Deputy Prime Ministers
- Municipal and Provincial Administrations
- As stated in Article 9
- Royal Gazette
- Documentation and Archive
